text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of summer camp,
where racers
train to improve their skills!

Okay, is everyone here? You're free to
do what
you want, but that doesn't mean
you can go
breaking rules left and right.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Don't do anything that'll cause the staff
here any
trouble, you hear? If I catch
any of you—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
What do you think you're doing, El?!
Quit eatin'
all those snacks before
mealtime!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But I skipped out on breakfast! I'm
staaarving!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Well, you do need some fuel to start the
day, but
sugary snacks won't do the job.
I've got some rice
balls here, so eat up!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Geez. Anyway! Make sure to greet your
camp
neighbors in nice, clear voices!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Also—hey, Sky! Stop playing video
games on the
bus! You'll give yourself a
headache!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Nooo, leave me alone. I'm so close to
the final
boss... I should be able to catch
this whale soon.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Sigh. Do you have anything for travel sickness? Here, take this!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
Сэйун Скай
choice_data_list: (They sure are a lot to handle...)

text_block_list.text:
This lot is nothing but a bunch of
troublemakers, I
swear!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, they sure are a free-spirited
bunch. You're
too easy on them,
Hishiama.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That's the leader of Miho
Dormitory for
you.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No, no! She's a more like a mom than a
dorm
leader!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It takes some time to get everyone
under control,
but Хиши Амадзон's
fiery-hot summer camp finally
kicks off!
